sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Whole script
sections.what: Reads the chosen runs and prints, for each, its status, totals, chart coverage for two views and the number of slides.
sections.why: Lets the owner choose a demo run by comparing numbers.
sections.watch_out: Running this does not change the demo. The demo pin is set by hand in another file.

summary: Reads saved Reality Scan runs and reports how many chart points each view plots and how big each deck is, to help pick a demo run.
purpose: Helps choose which saved scan should be the demo pin.
why: Likely reason: the demo should show a run with good chart coverage.
how: Takes run ids from the command line, or every whole-LNG run with a flag. For each run, prints its status, creation time and totals, then loads its deck and prints chart coverage for the delivery and portfolio views and the slide list. Reports a missing deck instead of failing.
inputs: Run ids on the command line, or the lng flag.
risks: Read-only, but reads the database. Exits with success even if some runs fail.
debug: If a run shows no deck, the run may not have finished. If coverage looks odd, check the chart coverage function it calls.
